name: General Conditions
description: Job-level costs that support the entire project but do not belong to a specific trade scope.

name: Temporary facilities
description: Portable toilets, dumpster rental, job trailer, storage containers, and any temporary site infrastructure needed to run the job.
help_text: Include all temporary site setup costs here. Do not split dumpster into haul-out — that goes to 01.40.

name: Temporary power & utilities
description: Temporary electrical service, generator rental, and temporary water service during construction.
help_text: Covers the cost of bringing and maintaining temporary utilities on site. Permanent utility connections go to 02.70.

name: Site safety & signage
description: OSHA-required signage, fencing, barrier tape, fall protection equipment, and any safety compliance costs.

name: Site cleanup & haul-out
description: Ongoing debris removal, broom-clean maintenance throughout construction, and routine haul-out during active phases. Final cleaning goes to 30.40.
help_text: This is ongoing mid-project cleanup. Final project cleaning and window cleaning belong in Category 30.

name: Superintendent / PM field labor
description: Direct field supervision and project management labor hours billed to this specific project.
help_text: Use for the actual hours your superintendent or PM works on this job. If you allocate shared supervision across multiple concurrent projects, that is an advanced accounting practice — talk to your accountant about adding a separate allocation line.

name: Builder's risk & project-specific insurance
description: Builder's risk policy premium for this project, installation floaters, and any project-specific bonds. Does not include your annual general liability premium.
help_text: Bill the actual premium for this project's builder's risk policy here. Your annual GL premium is a general overhead cost — fold it into your overhead rate in 29.10, not here. Putting both here causes double-counting.

name: Permits & plan check fees
description: Building permits, plan check fees, school fees, impact fees, and any government-required fees for this project.
help_text: Include all permit and government fee costs here regardless of who pulls the permit. If a change order triggers additional permit fees, those go to 28.40.

name: Engineering, survey & soils
description: Structural engineering, civil engineering, boundary and topographic surveys, soil reports, and geotechnical studies.

name: Testing & inspections
description: Third-party testing and special inspections: concrete testing, soils compaction, energy compliance, structural observations, and similar.
help_text: Covers independently contracted testing and inspections. Standard city inspections are covered by your permit fee in 01.70.

name: Site Work
description: Earthwork, grading, underground utilities, and site preparation before the foundation is placed.

name: Site clearing
description: Clearing trees, brush, existing vegetation, and debris from the building site.

name: Demo for new construction pad / prep
description: Demolition of existing structures, slabs, or improvements to prepare a cleared building site for new construction.
help_text: For demolition of an existing structure when building new. If you are remodeling or working within an occupied structure, use Category 26 instead.

name: Excavation
description: Bulk earthmoving for the building footprint, including excavation for basement, crawlspace, or slab preparation.

name: Rough grading
description: Initial rough grading to establish drainage slopes and rough building pad elevation.

name: Finish grading
description: Final grade work after construction is complete — directing drainage away from structure, preparing for landscape.

name: Drainage & storm management
description: Surface and subsurface drainage systems, French drains, swales, and storm water management.

name: Underground utilities
description: Trenching and installation of underground water, sewer, gas, and electrical service from the street or utility source to the structure.
help_text: Covers utility connections from source to the structure. Interior rough-in for each system goes in Categories 08–10.

name: Retaining walls
description: Structural retaining walls required for grade changes on site. Decorative landscape walls go to 24.60.
help_text: Structural retaining walls designed to hold grade go here. Decorative garden or landscape walls go to 24.60.

name: Erosion / dust control
description: Silt fencing, straw wattles, dust suppression, and any erosion control required by permit or site conditions.

name: Foundation & Concrete
description: All structural concrete work including footings, foundation walls, slabs, and waterproofing.

name: Footings
description: Excavation, forming, reinforcement, and poured concrete for structural footings.

name: Foundation walls / stem walls
description: Poured concrete or CMU foundation walls, stem walls, and cripple walls above the footings.

name: Slab on grade
description: Structural slab-on-grade including base prep, vapor barrier, reinforcement, and pour.

name: Basement / crawlspace slab
description: Interior slab for basement or crawlspace floor.

name: Garage slab
description: Garage floor slab including base prep and pour. Finish coatings go to 18.xx or 19.60.

name: Waterproofing & drainage
description: Below-grade waterproofing membranes, drain board, and footing drains.

name: Structural concrete / piers / grade beams
description: Concrete grade beams, drilled piers, caissons, and other structural concrete elements.

name: Flatwork adjacent to structure
description: Entry stoops, garage aprons, mechanical equipment pads, and any flatwork poured as part of the structural scope.
help_text: Use only for flatwork that is part of the foundation or structural scope — garage aprons, entry stoops, AC pads. Standalone driveways, walkways, and patios are Exterior Improvements and go to 24.10 or 24.20.

name: Radon rough-in
description: Radon mitigation sub-slab piping and vent sleeve installed before the slab is poured.

name: Framing & Structure
description: Rough lumber, engineered wood, structural steel, and all structural framing.

name: Floor framing
description: Floor joists, rim joists, blocking, and floor framing labor.

name: Wall framing
description: Exterior and interior wall framing including plates, studs, headers, and framing labor.

name: Roof framing
description: Roof rafters, ridge boards, hip and valley framing, ceiling joists, and trusses.

name: Roof sheathing
description: OSB or plywood roof deck sheathing supply and installation.

name: Wall sheathing
description: OSB or plywood wall sheathing supply and installation.

name: Engineered lumber / beams / headers
description: LVL beams, PSL posts, parallam, engineered joists, and prefabricated structural headers.

name: Structural steel
description: Steel beams, columns, moment frames, and custom steel structural elements.

name: Connectors / hardware / fasteners
description: Simpson connectors, hold-downs, post bases, structural screws, and framing hardware.
help_text: Usually included in the framing sub's bid. Use this line if you are purchasing hardware separately for your own crew.

name: Rough stair framing
description: Stair stringers and rough stair structure. Finish stair treads and railings go to 14.70.
help_text: Rough structure only. Finished stair treads, handrails, and balusters go to 14.70.

name: Roofing
description: Roofing system including underlayment, finish material, flashing, and gutters.

name: Roofing underlayment
description: Felt, synthetic underlayment, ice and water shield installed over roof sheathing.

name: Roofing material
description: Shingles, metal panels, tile, slate, TPO, EPDM, or other finish roofing material supply.

name: Roof flashing & sheet metal
description: Drip edge, valley flashing, step flashing at roof-wall intersections, chimney flashing, and skylight curb flashing.
help_text: Roof flashing only. Window head flashing, WRB, and wall waterproofing go to 07.20.

name: Gutters & downspouts
description: Gutter system supply and installation including downspouts and splash blocks.

name: Roof penetrations / specialty waterproofing
description: Skylights, roof windows, solar tube framing, pipe boots, HVAC curbs, and any specialty penetration waterproofing.

name: Roofing labor
description: Roofing installation labor only when tracked separately from material.
help_text: Only needed if your roofing sub invoices labor and material separately. Most roofing subs invoice as a package — put the total in 05.20 or 05.10 in that case.

name: Windows & Exterior Doors
description: Window and exterior door supply and installation.

name: Windows — supply
description: Window units supply cost including glazing, frames, and factory hardware.

name: Windows — install
description: Window installation labor including shimming, flashing integration, and sealing.

name: Exterior doors — supply
description: Exterior door units including frames, factory finish, and factory hardware.

name: Exterior doors — install
description: Exterior door installation labor including shimming, weatherstripping, and sealing.

name: Garage doors & openers
description: Garage door panels, tracks, openers, and keypads supply and installation.

name: Exterior hardware / specialty door items
description: Exterior locksets, deadbolts, door knobs, and any specialty door hardware not supplied with the unit.

name: Siding & Exterior Trim
description: Exterior wall cladding system including WRB, siding, masonry, trim, and exterior paint.

name: Housewrap / WRB
description: Primary water-resistive barrier installation — Tyvek, building paper, or similar.

name: WRB, wall flashing & waterproofing membrane
description: Window and door head flashing, through-wall flashing, window pan flashing, and cladding waterproofing layers.
help_text: Wall and window flashing only. Roof-related flashing goes to 05.30. Includes head flashing over windows and doors, sill pans, and all wall penetration waterproofing.

name: Siding / cladding
description: Lap siding, board and batten, fiber cement, wood, metal, or other exterior cladding system supply and installation.

name: Masonry veneer / stone
description: Brick veneer, stone veneer, stucco, EIFS, or other masonry cladding system.

name: Exterior trim
description: Exterior window casings, corner boards, belly bands, water table, and decorative exterior millwork.

name: Fascia / soffit
description: Fascia boards, soffit panels, and associated venting.

name: Exterior paint / stain
description: Exterior paint or stain applied to siding, trim, and wood elements. Touch-up after substantial completion goes to 19.30.
help_text: Primary exterior painting goes here during construction. Final touch-up paint at closeout goes to 19.30.

name: HVAC Rough
description: HVAC rough-in including ductwork, refrigerant lines, and equipment rough placement.

name: Ductwork
description: Sheet metal or flex ductwork supply and installation during rough phase.

name: Refrigerant lines
description: Refrigerant line sets run during rough phase for split systems.

name: Venting / exhaust
description: HVAC flue venting, bath exhaust, dryer exhaust, and kitchen hood rough ductwork.

name: Equipment rough placement
description: Setting and positioning of air handlers, furnaces, and large equipment during rough phase before drywall.

name: HVAC rough labor
description: HVAC rough-in labor when tracked separately from material and equipment.

name: Zone dampers / rough controls
description: Zone control dampers, actuators, and rough wiring for multi-zone systems.

name: Plumbing Rough
description: Rough plumbing including water supply, DWV, gas piping, and tub/shower rough-ins.

name: Water lines
description: Domestic water supply piping — copper, PEX, or CPVC — run during rough phase.

name: DWV / waste / vent
description: Drain, waste, and vent piping — ABS, PVC, or cast iron.

name: Gas piping
description: Natural gas or propane piping run during rough phase.

name: Tub / shower rough-ins
description: Tub and shower valve bodies, blocking, and rough-in for shower systems installed before drywall.

name: Specialty plumbing rough
description: Radiant heat tubing, recirculation loops, water softener rough-in, or other specialty plumbing.

name: Plumbing rough labor
description: Plumbing rough-in labor when tracked separately from material.

name: Electrical Rough
description: Electrical rough-in including service, panels, branch wiring, and device boxes.

name: Service / meter
description: Electrical service entrance, meter base, and connection to utility.

name: Main panel / subpanels
description: Main electrical panel, subpanels, and load center supply and installation.

name: Branch wiring
description: Rough branch circuit wiring throughout the structure.

name: Device boxes
description: Outlet, switch, and junction boxes set during rough phase.

name: Dedicated circuits
description: Dedicated circuits for appliances, HVAC, EV chargers, and specialty loads.

name: Electrical rough labor
description: Electrical rough-in labor when tracked separately from material.

name: Low Voltage / Specialty Rough
description: Low-voltage prewire for AV, data, security, automation, and specialty systems.

name: AV prewire
description: Audio/video prewire — speaker wire, HDMI, coax, and control wiring.

name: Data / Wi-Fi
description: Network cable, Cat6, and Wi-Fi access point wiring rough-in.

name: Security / cameras
description: Security system and camera prewire.

name: Shades / automation
description: Motorized shade and home automation control wiring.

name: Doorbell / access systems
description: Video doorbell, intercom, and access control prewire.

name: Fire sprinkler rough
description: Fire suppression system rough-in piping.

name: Specialty system prewire
description: Any other specialty low-voltage or control wiring not listed above.

name: Insulation & Air Sealing
description: All insulation and air sealing work.

name: Batt insulation — walls
description: Fiberglass or mineral wool batt insulation in wall cavities.

name: Batt insulation — attic / ceiling
description: Batt insulation in ceiling joists, attic knee walls, and rafter bays.

name: Blown-in or spray foam
description: Blown-in cellulose, fiberglass, or spray polyurethane foam insulation.

name: Rigid board insulation
description: Exterior continuous insulation, rigid foam sheathing, or under-slab insulation.

name: Air sealing & vapor barrier
description: Detailed air sealing, caulk, foam, and vapor barrier installation.

name: Sound insulation
description: Acoustic batt, resilient channel, and sound-dampening materials for party walls and floor/ceiling assemblies.

name: Insulation labor
description: Insulation installation labor when tracked separately from material.
help_text: Only use if your insulation sub invoices labor and material separately. Most insulation subs invoice as a package.

name: Drywall & Interior Shell
description: Drywall supply, hang, finish, and specialty interior shell work.

name: Drywall supply / hang
description: Drywall board supply and hanging labor — typically a combined sub invoice.

name: Drywall hang labor (if separated from supply)
description: Drywall hanging labor only when invoiced separately from board supply.
help_text: Only use if your drywall sub breaks out material and labor on separate invoices. Otherwise, use 13.10 for the combined cost.

name: Tape / mud / finish
description: Drywall taping, mudding, sanding, and finish coat labor.

name: Texture / specialty finish
description: Skip trowel, knockdown, smooth skim coat, or other specialty drywall textures.

name: Garage drywall & fire tape
description: Type X drywall and fire-rated tape in the garage per code.

name: Cement board / tile backer
description: Hardibacker, Durock, or similar tile backer installation in wet areas.

name: Specialty ceilings / framing details
description: Coffered, tray, barrel, or other specialty ceiling framing and backing details.

name: Interior Doors & Trim
description: Interior doors, hardware, and all interior trim and millwork.

name: Interior doors — supply
description: Interior door slabs, prehung units, and bifold or barn door hardware supply.

name: Interior doors — install
description: Interior door installation labor including fitting, shimming, and adjusting.

name: Interior door hardware
description: Passage sets, privacy locks, hinges, and interior door hardware supply.

name: Baseboard
description: Baseboard profile supply and installation.

name: Casing
description: Window and door interior casing supply and installation.

name: Crown / specialty trim
description: Crown molding, coffered ceiling trim, wainscoting, and other decorative molding.

name: Finish stair trim / railings
description: Finish stair treads, risers, handrails, newel posts, and balusters.
help_text: Finish stair elements installed after drywall. Rough stair framing goes to 04.90.

name: Millwork / decorative trim
description: Custom millwork, beams, mantels, built-in trim details, and specialty decorative elements.

name: Trim labor
description: Trim carpentry labor when tracked separately from material.

name: Cabinetry
description: All cabinetry supply and installation.

name: Kitchen cabinets — supply
description: Kitchen cabinet boxes, doors, drawers, and factory hardware supply.

name: Kitchen cabinets — install
description: Kitchen cabinet installation labor.

name: Bath cabinets / vanities — supply
description: Bathroom vanity cabinets and medicine cabinet supply.

name: Bath cabinets / vanities — install
description: Bathroom vanity installation labor.

name: Laundry / mudroom cabinetry
description: Laundry room, mudroom, and utility cabinetry supply and installation.

name: Built-ins
description: Custom built-in cabinetry, entertainment centers, office built-ins, and bookshelves.

name: Closet systems
description: Closet organizer systems — wire, laminate, or custom — supply and installation.

name: Cabinet hardware / accessories
description: Pulls, knobs, soft-close hinges, drawer slides, and interior organizers not included in cabinet supply.

name: Countertops
description: All countertop surfaces including template, fabrication, and installation.

name: Kitchen countertops
description: Kitchen countertop supply, fabrication, and installation.

name: Bath countertops
description: Bathroom vanity tops and countertop surfaces.

name: Laundry / mudroom tops
description: Laundry folding surfaces and mudroom countertops.

name: Specialty tops
description: Exterior BBQ countertops, bar tops, window sills, and non-standard countertop applications.

name: Template / fabrication / install
description: Templating fee, fabrication labor, and installation when billed separately from material.
help_text: Some fabricators include this in their total price. Use this line if labor and templating are invoiced separately from the stone or material cost.

name: Tile
description: All tile work including supply, waterproofing, and installation.

name: Shower walls
description: Wall tile supply and installation in showers and tub surrounds.

name: Shower pans / waterproofing
description: Shower pan liner, Schluter, or tile-ready pan and waterproofing membrane.

name: Floor tile
description: Floor tile supply and installation in baths, entries, laundry, and other tiled floors.

name: Backsplashes
description: Kitchen and bath tile backsplash supply and installation.

name: Fireplace tile / surround
description: Tile or stone surround for fireplace faces.

name: Specialty tile
description: Exterior tile, pool tile, decorative feature walls, and non-standard tile applications.

name: Tile labor
description: Tile setting labor when tracked separately from material supply.
help_text: Use if your tile sub separates material and labor on invoices. Otherwise, roll the full invoice into the relevant scope line above.

name: Flooring
description: All flooring materials and installation.

name: Hardwood flooring — supply
description: Solid or engineered hardwood flooring supply.

name: Hardwood flooring — install
description: Hardwood flooring installation labor.

name: LVP / resilient — supply
description: Luxury vinyl plank or tile, sheet vinyl, or other resilient flooring supply.

name: LVP / resilient — install
description: Resilient flooring installation labor.

name: Carpet
description: Carpet supply and installation — typically a combined sub invoice.

name: Floor prep / leveling
description: Self-leveling compound, subfloor patching, and floor preparation before finish flooring.

name: Floor finish / sanding / stain
description: Sanding, staining, and finishing of site-finished hardwood floors.

name: Paint & Wall Finishes
description: Interior and exterior paint and specialty wall finishes.

name: Prime / prep
description: Primer coats, surface preparation, caulking, and nail hole filling before finish paint.

name: Interior painting
description: Interior finish paint labor and material.

name: Exterior touch-up / finish paint
description: Final exterior paint touch-up at substantial completion. Primary exterior painting goes to 07.70.
help_text: Use for touch-up and final exterior paint at the end of the project. Primary exterior painting during construction goes to 07.70.

name: Wallcovering
description: Wallpaper supply and installation.

name: Specialty wall finishes
description: Venetian plaster, limewash, board and batten paint detailing, or other specialty finishes.

name: Stain / clear finish
description: Clear coat or stain on wood elements — doors, beams, cabinetry, or floors not covered above.

name: Plumbing Fixtures & Finish
description: Plumbing fixtures supply and trim-out installation.

name: Plumbing fixtures — supply
description: Tubs, showers, sinks, and bathing fixtures supply.

name: Faucets / trim — supply
description: Faucets, shower valves, trim kits, and finish plumbing trim supply.

name: Water heater / tankless
description: Water heater or tankless water heater supply and installation.

name: Toilets / sinks / accessories
description: Toilet supply, sink bowls, and bathroom accessories supply.

name: Plumbing fixture install / trim-out
description: Plumbing trim-out and fixture installation labor.

name: Appliance plumbing hookups
description: Final plumbing connections to dishwasher, refrigerator water line, ice maker, and similar.

name: Electrical Fixtures & Finish
description: Electrical fixtures supply and trim-out.

name: Decorative lighting — supply
description: Pendants, chandeliers, sconces, and decorative light fixture supply.

name: Recessed / can lighting
description: Recessed light trim, housings, and LED modules supply and installation.

name: Exterior lights
description: Exterior wall lights, soffit lights, and landscape uplights supply and installation.

name: Devices / switches / outlets
description: Outlet covers, switch plates, receptacles, and switches supply.

name: Ceiling fans
description: Ceiling fan supply and installation.

name: Electrical trim-out labor
description: Electrical trim-out and device installation labor.

name: Final electrical specialties
description: EV charger installation, specialty outlets, panel labeling, and final electrical items.

name: HVAC Equipment & Finish
description: HVAC equipment supply and commissioning.

name: Furnaces / air handlers
description: Furnace and air handler unit supply and installation.

name: Condensers / heat pumps
description: Outdoor condenser, heat pump, or air-to-air unit supply and installation.

name: Mini splits
description: Ductless mini split systems supply and installation.

name: ERV / HRV
description: Energy recovery or heat recovery ventilator supply and installation.

name: Thermostats / controls
description: Thermostat and zone control supply and installation.

name: Grilles / registers
description: Supply and return grille and register supply and installation.

name: HVAC startup / balancing / commissioning
description: System startup, air balancing, and commissioning by HVAC contractor.

name: Appliances
description: All appliance supply and installation.

name: Kitchen appliances
description: Refrigerator, range, dishwasher, microwave, hood, and other kitchen appliance supply.

name: Laundry appliances
description: Washer and dryer supply.

name: Specialty appliances
description: Wine cooler, beverage center, warming drawer, and other specialty appliance supply.

name: Appliance delivery / install
description: Appliance delivery, installation, and connection labor.

name: Exterior Improvements
description: Site improvements outside the building footprint.

name: Driveway
description: Driveway supply and installation — concrete, asphalt, or pavers.
help_text: Standalone driveways go here. Garage aprons poured as part of the structural scope belong in 03.80.

name: Walkways / patios / flatwork
description: Standalone walkways, patios, and decorative concrete or paver flatwork.
help_text: Standalone finished flatwork. Structural adjacent flatwork — stoops, aprons, equipment pads — goes to 03.80.

name: Decks
description: Deck framing, decking, and railing — all materials and labor.

name: Covered patios / pergolas
description: Covered patio structures, pergolas, and outdoor shade structures.

name: Exterior stairs / railings
description: Exterior stair systems and safety railings outside the building envelope.

name: Fencing & gates
description: Fencing, gates, and related hardware supply and installation.

name: Landscaping
description: Landscape design, planting, sod, seeding, and general landscape installation.

name: Irrigation
description: Irrigation system supply and installation.

name: Outdoor lighting
description: Landscape and pathway lighting.

name: Outdoor kitchen / fire pit / exterior features
description: Outdoor kitchen, BBQ island, fire pit, and related exterior living features.

name: Specialties
description: Specialty systems and features not covered in standard trade categories.

name: Fireplace equipment
description: Fireplace insert, gas firebox, or wood-burning unit supply and installation.

name: Fireplace surround / finish
description: Fireplace surround, hearth extension, and mantel — supply and installation.

name: Smart home / AV equipment
description: Control processors, amplifiers, speakers, TVs, and AV equipment supply and installation.

name: Security / camera equipment
description: Security panel, sensors, cameras, and NVR supply and installation.

name: Solar / battery
description: Solar panel array, inverter, and battery storage supply and installation.

name: Generator / transfer switch
description: Standby generator and automatic transfer switch supply and installation.

name: Elevator / lift
description: Residential elevator or platform lift supply and installation.

name: Sauna / steam
description: Pre-built sauna unit or steam system supply and installation.

name: Wine room / specialty systems
description: Wine room refrigeration, humidification, and specialty system supply and installation.

name: Pool / spa
description: Swimming pool and/or spa supply and installation — all scope.

name: Remodel Conditions
description: Remodel and addition-specific scope covering demolition, protection, and hidden conditions.

name: Selective demolition
description: Careful removal of specific finishes, fixtures, or components while preserving adjacent work.
help_text: Use for controlled demolition where surrounding areas must be protected. Full structural demo goes to 26.20.

name: Structural demolition
description: Removal of walls, floors, rooflines, or other structural elements.

name: Investigative demo
description: Targeted opening of walls, floors, or ceilings to assess existing conditions before pricing.
help_text: Use when you are opening walls or floors to investigate — not yet committing to full demolition. Costs discovered here often generate hidden condition line items.

name: Interior protection
description: Dust walls, zippered barriers, and containment systems to protect occupied or finished areas.

name: Floor / finish protection
description: Rosin paper, Ram Board, carpet masks, and other installed surface protection.

name: Temporary partitions
description: Temporary walls or closures for weather protection or occupant separation.

name: Debris hauling & disposal
description: Dumpster, haul-away, and disposal fees for remodel debris.

name: Temporary shoring
description: Temporary structural shoring required during wall removal or structural modification.

name: Hidden conditions allowance
description: Budget reserve for concealed damage, rot, mold, outdated wiring, or other unforeseen conditions discovered during demolition.
help_text: Always set a non-zero amount here. A good starting point is 5–15% of your rough scope cost. In cost-plus contracts, actual costs are billed at cost. In fixed-price, define your allowance threshold and CO process upfront. This is the most important line in a remodel budget.

name: Code compliance upgrades
description: Electrical panel upgrades, egress window additions, smoke/CO detector upgrades, and other code-triggered work.
help_text: When a permit triggers code upgrades that were not part of the original scope — new smoke detectors, GFCI, egress — track those costs here.

name: Matching existing conditions
description: Labor and material to match existing paint colors, trim profiles, flooring species, or finishes.
help_text: Matching existing conditions is real cost — custom stain matching, profiled trim milling, and blending new flooring into existing runs all take time. Budget it explicitly.

name: Temporary services / occupant protection
description: Temporary heat, lighting, or weather protection for occupied or partially-occupied remodel projects.

name: Allowances & Selections
description: Owner-directed allowances for items not yet selected at contract execution.

name: Tile allowance
description: Allowance for tile selections not yet finalized.
help_text: Set the allowance dollar amount based on your estimated tile budget. When the client selects tile, update the actual cost. Overages generate a change order.

name: Flooring allowance
description: Allowance for flooring selections not yet finalized.

name: Lighting allowance
description: Allowance for decorative lighting selections.

name: Plumbing fixture allowance
description: Allowance for plumbing fixtures and faucets not yet selected.

name: Appliance allowance
description: Allowance for kitchen and laundry appliance selections.

name: Landscape allowance
description: Allowance for landscaping and irrigation not yet designed.

name: Client upgrades
description: Owner-directed upgrades added to scope after contract execution but tracked as selections rather than formal change orders.

name: Owner-supplied item coordination
description: Coordination and installation of owner-furnished items — allowance for labor and logistics.
help_text: When the owner supplies an item but you install it, budget the coordination and installation labor here.

name: Long-lead selections tracking
description: Placeholder for tracking long-lead items ordered early — tile, fixtures, appliances — to monitor delivery status.
help_text: Use as a tracking placeholder for items ordered far in advance. Move the actual cost to the relevant scope line when invoiced.

name: Change Orders & Contingency
description: Change orders, contract adjustments, and contingency reserves.

name: Owner change orders — labor
description: Labor cost for owner-directed scope changes.

name: Client credits / contract deductions
description: Formal credit change orders reducing the contract value.
help_text: Enter as a negative dollar amount. Use for formal credit change orders only — value engineering credits, scope reductions, or owner-approved deductions. Do not use for allowance underruns — those are handled in Category 27.

name: Owner change orders — material
description: Material cost for owner-directed scope changes.

name: Owner change orders — subcontractor
description: Subcontractor cost for owner-directed scope changes.

name: Permit / fee impacts from change orders
description: Additional permit fees, school fees, or government fees triggered by scope changes.

name: Builder rework
description: Cost of correcting builder errors, rework, or failures in supervision.
help_text: Internal tracking only. Never billable to the owner. Track this to understand your actual margin and supervision quality. Keeping this visible to your team holds subs accountable.
notes: Default billable=false and client_visible=false enforced at the record level. Do not override without purpose.

name: Trade backcharges
description: Amounts recovered from subcontractors for poor work, damage, or failure to perform.
help_text: Internal recovery tracking. When you charge a sub back for damage or rework, log it here. This is not a client-facing item.
notes: Default billable=false and client_visible=false. This is internal recovery logic, not a budget cost.

name: Design contingency
description: Reserve for design changes and scope evolution during preconstruction and early construction.
help_text: Use for changes that arise from evolving design decisions — not owner scope changes and not hidden conditions. Typically 3–5% of contract value on new builds.

name: Hidden condition contingency
description: Reserve for unforeseen conditions not covered by the remodel conditions allowance.
help_text: Separate from the remodel conditions allowance in 26.90. Use this for contingency on new builds or for additional reserve on complex remodels.

name: Allowance overage contingency
description: Reserve to absorb owner selection overruns above the budgeted allowance amounts.
help_text: When selections consistently run over allowance, this reserve absorbs the gap. In cost-plus, overages are billed directly. In fixed-price, this reserve protects your margin.

name: Overhead & Fees
description: Builder overhead, profit, and fee structure — separate from physical scope.

name: Builder overhead
description: General overhead costs — office, vehicles, tools, insurance allocation, and other operating costs allocated to this project.
help_text: Fold your annual GL premium, vehicle costs, office costs, and tool depreciation into this line as a percentage of project cost or a fixed allocation. Do not also list insurance at 01.60 — that is for project-specific builder's risk only.

name: Builder fee / profit
description: Builder profit margin on the project.
help_text: Your margin. In cost-plus, this is your stated fee. In fixed-price, it is embedded in your contract price — use this line to track it internally for reporting.

name: Project management fee
description: Separately stated PM fee when billed as a line item distinct from overhead.
help_text: Only activate if you bill PM as a separate contract line item. Most builders include PM in their overhead or fee. Do not use alongside 01.50 for the same labor.

name: Warranty reserve
description: Internal reserve for anticipated post-completion warranty and callback costs.
help_text: Set aside a small reserve — typically 0.5–1% of contract value — to cover anticipated warranty calls in the first year. Track actual warranty costs in Category 30.

name: GC-held design fees
description: Architect, interior designer, or consultant fees that the GC carries and manages on behalf of the owner.
help_text: Use when design fees flow through your contract rather than direct to the owner. If the owner contracts directly with designers, do not use this line.

name: Punch, Closeout & Warranty
description: Final punch, closeout activities, and post-completion warranty service.

name: Punch labor
description: General contractor and self-perform labor for punch list items.

name: Trade callbacks
description: Subcontractor return visits to address punch list items.

name: Final corrections
description: Material and labor for final corrections identified at substantial completion.

name: Final cleaning
description: Deep cleaning of the entire project at substantial completion.

name: Window cleaning
description: Professional window cleaning at closeout.

name: Owner orientation
description: Walk-through and orientation session to familiarize the owner with systems and finishes.

name: Manuals / attic stock / closeout docs
description: Owner manuals, warranty documents, attic stock material, and project closeout documentation package.

name: Final inspections
description: Certificate of occupancy inspection, final building inspection, and any trade final inspections.

name: Warranty service calls
description: Labor for post-completion warranty service visits.

name: Warranty repairs
description: Material and subcontractor cost for warranty repairs.

name: Seasonal adjustments
description: Return visits for seasonal items — grading settlement, caulk shrinkage, door adjustments, and other time-dependent items.
help_text: Budget for at least one seasonal return visit. Many warranty items only appear after the first heating/cooling cycle or after the first wet season.
